system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Engine, Perceiver, and Inbox never access AgentConfig. Only the DM prompt builder reads it.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts built per-scene from YAML character/scene config; DM prompt builder in dm/prompt.py.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Perception rules filter the world per character. Three agents in the same room hold three completely different pictures of what's happening.
env_context_strategy.note: Agents call GET /perceive each tick to get their filtered world slice; closest value is agent-driven navigation of the world state.

observation_format.evidence_quote: uncertain ones go to an LLM-based **Dungeon Master (DM)** that returns structured effects, not free prose.
observation_format.note: Perception payloads are structured world state; DM returns validated DMResponse (narrative + effects).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Uses LiteLLM + Instructor for structured output.
tool_call_format.note: DM uses Instructor structured (JSON schema) output; external agents post actions to /act as JSON params rather than provider tool calls.

tool_count.note: Action set is defined per scene YAML, not a fixed default tool list in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Entity** = world state only (id, type, flat properties). No personality, no goals.
edit_primitive.note: Engine exposes world actions/effects, not file-edit primitives; workers write files with their own external tooling.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
YAML defines engine actions. `publish` is a `ws.py` helper used by Codex
subagents.
tool_schema_source.note: Action params declared by hand in scene YAML.

protocol_standardization.note: Interface is a proprietary HTTP/WebSocket API; no MCP/A2A in the evidenced file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each tick: every agent perceives its own filtered slice, proposes an action, and the engine resolves it.
loop_primitives.note: Tick loop with signals/inbox wakes; Codex adapter adds a producer/critic/curation flow.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `trajectory.md` is for Codex and subagents during the run.
planning_granularity.note: Core engine has no plan object; Codex adapter keeps a trajectory.md operating plan (would be explicit_plan_object in that opt-in runtime).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A multi-agent world engine where AI agents live, talk, compete, ally.
multi_agent_topology.note: Codex adapter offers an orchestrator/worker variant: primary session spawns subagents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: InboxManager | `engine/inbox.py` | Per-agent inbox for events and whispers.
delegation_mechanism.note: Agents communicate via engine events/inboxes; Codex adapter also supports subagent_spawn.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Intervene**: whisper privately to any agent, nudge the story.
human_in_loop.note: Human can watch, whisper/intervene, or play a character; no per-action approval gate evidenced, so on_permission is the closest value for steering.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: StateStore | `engine/state_store.py` | Entity CRUD. All state as flat properties.

long_term_memory.note: Durable workspace lanes/files plus shipped skills/ directory (create-world, asset-sourcing).

self_verification.evidence_quote: Critics reject anything generic. Audience agents judge what feels useful.
self_verification.note: Critique/peer-review is scene-configured; the DM itself is an LLM judge of action outcomes. Autoresearch scenes also run experiments.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: research -> generate -> critique -> revise -> select -> package
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry policy in the engine; revision loops are scene-level behaviour.

rollback.evidence_quote: `stream.jsonl`: append-only event stream (event, action, dm_call, perceive, register, wakeup, whisper).
rollback.note: Event-sourced log and state snapshots exist but no documented rollback/undo of agent changes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
For Codex-subagent runs, avoid low world `max_ticks` limits. Use
`scene.max_ticks: null`
termination_condition.note: max_ticks caps the tick loop; can be null for unbounded.

cost_controls.note: DM call rate cap plus per-call token tracking and summary token totals; closest value is token_budget. Fallback model support is failover, not routing.

timeouts.note: Signal wait timeout; no run-level wall-clock timeout evidenced.

execution_isolation.note: Engine and agents run locally as host processes; autoresearch ships an ec2_runner for remote experiment execution.

filesystem_access.note: Convention-level scoping to per-agent lanes within the workspace; not enforced by an OS boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: One agent studies a new API. Builder agents create competing demos.
network_policy.note: No network restriction configuration evidenced; agents call external LLM providers and APIs.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
The engine validates the action params, records the event, routes inboxes, and
may emit a director signal.
permission_model.note: Only actions declared in scene YAML, passing DSL preconditions, are executed (engine/action_policy.py).

tracing.evidence_quote: `stream.jsonl`: append-only event stream (event, action, dm_call, perceive, register, wakeup, whisper).

replayability.evidence_quote: Every run is different. Past runs are preserved and replayable.

eval_hooks.note: Only unit/e2e/scenario test suites; no benchmark evaluation runner in the evidenced tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: For each action, `RulesEngine` checks preconditions (DSL expressions).
guardrails.note: Also `hidden_properties`: properties never sent to agents, an output/perception filter.

target_domain.evidence_quote: The same engine can run production rooms, simulations, games, and fictional worlds.
target_domain.note: Primary domain is multi-agent social simulation / world modelling (`other`); autoresearch scene targets research.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Add your API key (any LiteLLM provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.)

pinned_version.note: No tagged release given in evidence; pinned to the evidenced main commit.
